change.owner_request_exact: Can we change the ceiling to be 2048MiB instead?

effective_config.decision_rule: Blocked host, missing controls or incomplete comparison => INCONCLUSIVE_REVISE, no model ranking. Complete inadequate comparison => DEFER. Passing permits only a supervised opt-in integration experiment under separate #75 authorization.
effective_config.metal: not attempted; support unverified; requires a separate frozen variant
effective_config.execution: Rust preview only; no approval or RDF execution command; no #75 integration
effective_config.thermal: No thermal/performance warning, CPU limits absent or 100 percent; AC power required
effective_config.mode: diagnostic_only: independent semantic observations; no semantic GO or strict evaluation
effective_config.evaluation_exposure: All 30 #72 evaluation cases already exposed by #74; not a pristine holdout
effective_config.hypothesis: Lossless packet-only columnar presentation fits the existing context budget without changing source information or retrieval membership. Semantic effects of the presentation are unknown.
effective_config.controls_before_smoke: All semantic controls and six smoke cases attempted independently in each condition. Semantic failure and individually rejected drafts remain failures. Runtime, integrity, resource and authorization failures stop all later observations.
effective_config.scoring: Original exact exposed-reference scores immutable. Ambiguity and source-evidence audit reported separately; pending independent human review.
effective_config.scope_policy: Original authorized source only. Separate oracle and frozen whole-question BM25-v1 diagnostic records; neighborhood-v2 not registered.
effective_config.source_evidence: Same authorized source edges and collisions as v1d; source names grouped by original language, predicate IRI local names extracted mechanically. No translations, invented property definitions, selected IDs or gold directions.

repeatability.gate: Diagnostic measurement only; failed repeat recorded. Exact prompt and request identity mismatch is a fatal integrity failure.

rationale_review.method: Blind independent human review pending; source sufficiency audit is AI investigator analysis only.
rationale_review.gate: No semantic GO; unsupported or unreviewed claims are not validated.

effective_config.comparison: r3 oracle unchanged; r3 retrieval retains every original packet value under a reversible representation. This is a presentation/budget ablation, not a semantic prompt or retrieval change.
effective_config.token_fit_rule: input_tokens + 512 < 16384; every scheduled prompt is recounted with pinned local tokenizer before model loading; native template/token parity is mandatory before each generation

attempt_ledger: Shared parent freeze/model ledger; original and variant are not separate retry allowances.
